title: Design System: 首爾散步手帳 (Seoul Notebook)

display.purpose: Trip title in the navy band only (h1).

title.purpose: Place name in each stop pane.

note.purpose: Stop notes and the note editor.

period-label.purpose: Period names in the sticky lattice column.

label.purpose: Small tracked labels: meta, tab weekday, category, note label, count, footer.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for the lamp sweep, link arrow nudge, disclosure marker and pane settle.

motion.name: lamp-sweep
motion.purpose: Active day tab fill rises from the bottom (scaleY 0 to 1).

motion.name: pane-in
motion.value: opacity .85 to 1, .7s var(--ease-out), 45ms stagger capped at 10
motion.purpose: Stop panes settle once when a day is shown.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled brand-blue square button for the main action (sign in, import, save).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--blue, #163b9c); border-radius: 0; background: var(--blue, #163b9c); color: #fff; font-family: "Pretendard Seoul", "Noto Sans TC", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .08em; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s, border-color .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--night, #0c1c47); border-color: var(--night, #0c1c47); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #163b9c); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: default; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Ruled square secondary button (sign out, reload, cancel).
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--blue, #163b9c); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--blue, #163b9c); font-family: "Pretendard Seoul", "Noto Sans TC", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: .08em; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--pane, #fff); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #163b9c); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square ruled field with a tracked label above.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: "Pretendard Seoul", "Noto Sans TC", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .14em; color: var(--muted-ink, #4a5a82); max-width: 320px; } .ds-input { border: 1px solid var(--blue, #163b9c); border-radius: 0; background: var(--pane, #fff); color: var(--ink, #0c1c47); padding: 11px 12px; font: inherit; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: normal; caret-color: var(--blue, #163b9c); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #163b9c); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Day Tabs
components.description: Lattice row of day panes in the navy band; the active pane fills lamp amber from the bottom.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); background: var(--night, #0c1c47); border-top: 1px solid var(--night-line, #2b3d72); border-left: 1px solid var(--night-line, #2b3d72); font-family: "Pretendard Seoul", "Noto Sans TC", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 6px; padding: 20px 22px 18px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--night-line, #2b3d72); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--night-soft, #aebbe0); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: color .3s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); } .ds-tab::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: var(--lamp, #f3b94d); transform: scaleY(0); transform-origin: bottom; transition: transform .5s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--paper, #eef2f8); } .ds-tab.is-active, .ds-tab.is-active:hover { color: var(--night, #0c1c47); } .ds-tab.is-active::before { transform: scaleY(1); } .ds-tab strong { font-size: 56px; font-weight: 200; line-height: .9; letter-spacing: -.04em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-tab.is-active strong { font-weight: 300; } .ds-tab span { font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .16em; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lamp, #f3b94d); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-pane { display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-width: 420px; padding: 22px 24px 0; background: var(--pane, #fff); color: var(--ink, #0c1c47); border: 1px solid var(--line, #163b9c); font-family: "Pretendard Seoul", "Noto Sans TC", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-pane-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; font-size: 12px; } .ds-cat, .ds-region { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; letter-spacing: .08em; color: var(--muted-ink, #4a5a82); } .ds-cat { color: var(--ink, #0c1c47); margin-right: auto; } .ds-time { margin: 18px 0 2px; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 250; letter-spacing: -.03em; line-height: 1.1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-place { margin: 8px 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: -.01em; } .ds-note { margin: 0 -24px; padding: 14px 24px 18px; border-top: 1px dashed rgb(22 59 156 / .35); } .ds-note-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .14em; color: var(--muted-ink, #4a5a82); } .ds-note p { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.85; } .ds-pane-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0 16px; min-height: 52px; margin: 0 -24px; padding: 4px 24px; border-top: 1px solid rgb(22 59 156 / .18); font-size: 12px; } .ds-provider { letter-spacing: .14em; color: var(--ok, #1f6b4a); font-weight: 600; } .ds-map { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--blue, #163b9c); text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-map:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-map:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #163b9c); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-lattice { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 140px minmax(0, 1fr); border: 1px solid var(--line, #163b9c); font-family: "Pretendard Seoul", "Noto Sans TC", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-period { padding: 22px 20px; background: var(--paper, #eef2f8); border-right: 1px solid var(--line, #163b9c); } .ds-period h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .14em; color: var(--blue, #163b9c); } .ds-cells { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 1px; background: var(--line-soft, #adbadc); } .ds-cell { min-height: 96px; padding: 22px 24px; background: var(--pane, #fff); color: var(--ink, #0c1c47); font-size: 15px; } .ds-ttisal { --rails: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(22 59 156 / .2) 0 1px, transparent 1px 6px); background: var(--rails) 0 14% / 100% 13px no-repeat, var(--rails) 0 50% / 100% 13px no-repeat, var(--rails) 0 86% / 100% 13px no-repeat, repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 15px, rgb(22 59 156 / .07) 15px 16px), var(--paper, #eef2f8); }

components.css: .ds-disclosure { border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #163b9c); font-family: "Pretendard Seoul", "Noto Sans TC", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-disclosure summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: fit-content; min-height: 52px; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: .14em; color: var(--blue, #163b9c); } .ds-disclosure summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-disclosure summary::before { content: ""; width: 9px; height: 9px; border: 1px solid var(--blue, #163b9c); transition: background .2s, transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); } .ds-disclosure[open] summary::before { background: var(--blue, #163b9c); transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-disclosure summary:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 5px; } .ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #163b9c); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-disclosure p { margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted-ink, #4a5a82); }

narrative.northStar: The Hanok Window at Blue Hour
narrative.overview:
The page is a 창살 (hanok window lattice) seen at dusk. A deep night-navy band holds the title, a hand-drawn line skyline of Seoul, and a row of day panes; the chosen day glows lamp amber, like one lit paper window. Below the band the ground turns to cool frost paper, and the day's stops sit in white panes held by a lattice of 1px rules. The surface reads as a calm, unhurried notebook rather than a trip-planner app.

Density comes from structure, not decoration: every division is a hairline rule, every corner is square, and hierarchy comes from scale contrast between very large, very light numerals and small, widely tracked labels. Titles are set in a brush-kai face (LXGW WenKai TC) so the Traditional Chinese reads as handwritten journal headings; everything else is a quiet sans. Motion is limited to the lamp sweeping into the active day and the panes settling once.

The build rejects the category default of rounded white cards on grey with pill tabs; this is confirmed in the direction contract and holds across the build.
keyCharacteristics: Navy band over frost paper; two grounds, never a third.
One lamp: amber only marks what is lit (active day, its focus ring, text selection).
Square corners and 1px rules everywhere; frame rules in brand blue, inner muntins in soft blue.
Huge thin numerals against tiny tracked labels.
Line-illustration imagery drawn in the palette's own strokes, never photography.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Lamp amber marks only the lit state: the active day pane, focus within the day tabs, and text selection. If an element is not "the one lit thing", it is not amber.

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: Night navy above, frost paper below. Panes are white; there is no grey and no third surface color.

rules.name: The Frame and Muntin Rule
rules.body: The lattice uses two rule weights by color, not by thickness: the outer frame and period dividers are brand blue (#163b9c); the muntins between stop panes are soft blue (#adbadc). Both are 1px.

rules.name: The Scale Contrast Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from size and weight extremes: numerals and times go thin (200–300) and large; labels go small and tracked. Never fake hierarchy with bold mid-sized type.

rules.name: The Brush for Titles Rule
rules.body: LXGW WenKai TC is used for h1 and h2 only. Labels, numerals, buttons and body stay in the sans.

rules.name: The Paper Window Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift. A pane is distinguished by its fill and its 1px frame, never by a shadow.

dos: Do separate everything with 1px rules: brand blue (#163b9c) for frames, soft blue (#adbadc) for muntins between panes, night rule (#2b3d72) inside the band.
Do keep every corner square (0px), including inputs and buttons.
Do set h1 and h2 in LXGW WenKai TC and everything else in Pretendard Seoul with Noto Sans TC.
Do make large numerals thin (200–300) and labels small and tracked (0.14–0.2em).
Do fill an odd lattice cell with the unlit 띠살 pane rather than leaving a gap.
Do draw imagery as line illustration in the palette's own stroke colors.
Do honor reduced motion: all animation and transitions snap off.
donts: Don't use lamp amber (#f3b94d) for anything except the active day tab, focus inside the day tabs, and text selection.
Don't round corners or use pill tabs and rounded white cards on grey.
Don't add drop shadows to lift panes or buttons.
Don't introduce a third ground color between navy and frost paper.
Don't reintroduce numbered stop indices; they were removed as unclear.
